title: Poison at the Cooking Final
call: Inspector {name}, a judge collapsed during the live final of 'India's Top Cook'.
Millions watched him take one bite and fall. The studio is locked.
arrival: The cameras are still rolling. The contestants stand frozen at their stations.

briefing.label: Victim
briefing.value: Judge Chef Kapoor. Alive, in hospital.

examination.title: Examine the judge's plate

spots.title: Spoon
spots.text: Tiny white crystals on the spoon. Not salt, not sugar.

spots.title: Smell
spots.text: It smells of bitter almonds. Biryani should never smell like that.

examination.question: What made the judge collapse?
examination.why: Strange white crystals and a bitter almond smell, after one bite. That's poison.

interview.alibi: I was plating my dessert at station 2 the whole time.
replies: Yes, I'm a contestant. All four of us took plates to the judge.
gotchas: This blue thread matches the torn corner of YOUR apron, Meenakshi!
The bottle was in the bin right next to YOUR station, Meenakshi!

interview.alibi: I was frying pakoras. Hot oil, you can't leave it for a second!
replies: Contestant, yes. I took my pakoras to the judge first.
Blue apron, yes, but look, mine isn't torn anywhere.
My station is by the window, but I never left my pan. The camera was on me.
interview.release: The camera filmed Bunty frying pakoras without a break.

interview.alibi: I was grinding chutney on my stone, beta. My arms still hurt!
replies: A contestant at 72 years old, yes!
Blue? My apron is red, beta. My lucky colour.
Window side, yes. But I can't even open those tiny bottles. Look at my hands.
interview.release: The sound engineer heard Sushila's grinding stone for the whole round.

leads.from: 🥄 Crystals on the spoon, but not in the pot
leads.question: The rest of the biryani in the pot is fine. When was the poison added?
options: 🥄 After serving, on the judge's plate
wrongWhy: Then every plate would be poisoned.
Then the whole pot would be poisoned too.
leads.reveal: After serving! You check the judges' tasting table…
leads.name: Tasting table
leads.found: The tasting table is behind a rope. Only **CONTESTANTS** carry plates up to it. There's a **blue thread** caught on its corner.
leads.ask: Cross out everyone who is NOT a contestant.
leads.why: Only contestants went up to the tasting table.
leads.card: Only CONTESTANTS reach the tasting table

leads.from: 🧵 A blue thread on the table's corner
leads.question: The thread is caught at waist height, as someone leaned over the plate. What did it come from?
wrongWhy: A cap isn't at waist height.
Shoes don't reach the table top.
leads.reveal: An apron! Pandu holds the thread up to the light…
leads.name: Apron thread
leads.found: A thread of **BLUE apron** fabric, torn as someone leaned over the judge's plate.
leads.ask: Tap everyone left who wears a blue apron.
leads.why: Meenakshi, Bunty and Rohan all wear blue aprons.
leads.card: A BLUE APRON thread at the tasting table

leads.from: 🧪 The poison came in something small
leads.question: The thief had to get rid of the poison bottle fast, before the cameras turned. Where?
wrongWhy: Then the whole pot would be poisoned.
The studio was locked. Nobody went home.
leads.reveal: The nearest bin! You search the bins by the stations…
leads.name: Tiny bottle
leads.found: A tiny bottle that smells of bitter almonds, in the bin of the **WINDOW SIDE** stations.
leads.ask: Cross out everyone left who does NOT cook on the window side.
leads.why: Rohan's station is on the door side.
leads.card: The poison bottle in a WINDOW SIDE bin

confession: "Twenty years ago he stole my mother's biryani recipe and got famous with it. Tonight he tasted it one more time."
escapeStory: Meenakshi walked out with the studio audience. She was caught at the bus stand, still wearing her apron.
